steps.action: Tick 'Trainer' on a staff member
user_sees: The person marked Trainer; their role stays what it was

steps.action: On a member's page, pick that trainer
user_sees: The member assigned
must_not: A member of another gym assigned

steps.action: Open 'Training progress'
user_sees: Every member who shares, with their weekly summary and trainer

steps.action: Open the member's Progress
user_sees: Their summary and recent workouts, or that they do not share

steps.action: Assign a member to someone who is not ticked as Trainer
user_sees: Refused (NOT_TRAINER)

steps.action: Tick a person who was removed from the gym
user_sees: Refused (NOT_FOUND)
must_not: A removed person made a trainer

start: A ticked trainer with assigned members

steps.action: Untick 'Trainer'
user_sees: Their members are unassigned at once
must_not: The person still seeing those members

steps.action: Remove the person from the gym
user_sees: Trainer tick and assignments go at once

steps.action: Open 'Training progress'
user_sees: The owner sees every sharing member, with name and phone from the list
must_not: Front desk without the tick seeing it (TRAINER_ONLY)
Body weight, photos, notes or food

start: Admin app signed in as a ticked trainer with assigned members

steps.action: Open 'Training progress'
user_sees: Only their own members who share, each with weeks, best lifts and new records

steps.action: See a member who tapped 'Ask my trainer for help'
user_sees: The help mark with its time
must_not: The mark on a member of another trainer

steps.action: Answer a question a member sent to this trainer
user_sees: The answer saved; the member's phone gets a pop-up
must_not: The reply lost if the pop-up fails
Questions picked for another person shown

steps.action: Open the Progress of a member not assigned to them
user_sees: Not allowed

steps.action: The tick is taken away; open 'Training progress'
user_sees: Refused (TRAINER_ONLY)

steps.action: The member switches sharing off
user_sees: The member no longer listed

steps.action: The owner moves the member to another trainer
user_sees: The member goes from this trainer's list

steps.action: Look for feedback, complaints or other members' data
user_sees: Only their own members' summaries and questions

start: Member app joined and matched to the gym's list; 'Share my workouts with my trainers' is on

steps.action: Train; the phone sends a weekly summary and recent workouts
user_sees: Settings shows sharing on and the trainer's first name
must_not: Body weight, photos, notes or food sent

steps.action: Tap 'Ask my trainer for help'
user_sees: Sent; a second tap the same day says it was already sent
must_not: Two help marks in one day

steps.action: Tap 'Ask my trainer for help'
user_sees: Refused: not shared (NOT_SHARED; app words unknown)
must_not: A help mark sent while sharing is off

steps.action: A phone sends a summary that is too big or wrong
user_sees: Refused (INVALID)

steps.action: Switch sharing off
user_sees: The summary is deleted at once

steps.action: Leave the gym
user_sees: The summary is deleted at once and never sent again
must_not: The phone's next send storing it again after leaving

start: A member who shares with trainers, then leaves the gym

steps.action: The app keeps its old switch on and sends again
user_sees: The send is refused: the member has left
must_not: A new summary stored for a member who left, against the privacy notice
